in_sanskrit.name: इस्मिता
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is desirable, the one who is the cause of desire, the one who is passionate, the one who is the embodiment of love.

in_hindi.name: इस्मिता
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who is the cause of desire (Isma ka ta).

in_tamil.name: இஸ்மிதா
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who is the cause of desire (Ismathalai).

in_telugu.name: ఇస్మితా
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who is the embodiment of desire (Ismēśa cheyyadū).

in_marathi.name: Ismita
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of knowledge
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ismita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘ismana’ (God) and ‘vidya’ (knowledge). The name Ismita signifies the goddess of knowledge and wisdom. In Hindu mythology, the goddess Saraswati is often referred to as the embodiment of knowledge and learning.
